theme_and_identity.tone: Earthy, poetic-but-rigorous, authentic, editorial, 'rigenerativo non decorativo'
theme_and_identity.theme_mode: Light theme dominant (off-white paper) with dark earth/forest contrasting sections.

headings.usage: H1 to H4. Hero heading must be massive (text-6xl+) with tight tracking. Use italics for poetic emphasis.

accents_and_labels.usage: Numbered manifesto chapters (e.g., '01.', '02.'), tiny labels, language toggle.

primary_bg.name: Off-White Paper
primary_bg.usage: Main background for hero, about, and general sections.

primary_text.name: Deep Forest Green
primary_text.usage: Headings, body text on light backgrounds. Used for the logo.

secondary_bg.name: Deep Soil
secondary_bg.usage: Background for contrasting sections like 'R'Accolti' or footer.

accent_honey.name: Warm Honey / Amber
accent_honey.usage: Accent color for the 'Bee Humus' section, buttons, and highlights.

accent_sage.name: Pale Sage
accent_sage.usage: Secondary background for cards or bento grids to provide subtle contrast against off-white.

layouts_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing, The Swiss Grid but organic and asymmetrical.
layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-8, p-12, p-24, p-32. Sections should have massive vertical padding (py-32).
layouts_and_spacing.bento_asymmetry: Use Mode A (The 'Tetris' Grid). Never center everything. Use col-span-8 for main images and col-span-4 for offset text to create tension and negative space.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: MUST use @studio-freight/lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the site a premium editorial feel.
motion_and_interactions.hero_kinetic_reveal: Wrap hero text lines in overflow-hidden containers. Use framer-motion to animate text translating from y: '100%' to y: 0 with an ease-out-cubic curve and slight stagger.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion 'whileInView'. Elements should fade in and translate up slightly (y: 20 -> y: 0).
motion_and_interactions.image_parallax: Images should have scale: 1.1 inside overflow-hidden wrappers, and scale down to 1.0 or shift y-axis slightly on scroll using framer-motion useScroll.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Style: Slow, editorial ribbon. Font: Cormorant Garamond, pale sage background with forest green text.

visual_enhancers.3d_elements: Use react-three-fiber and @react-three/drei in the Hero section. Render a subtle, slow-rotating abstract 'sprouting seed' or floating earth/pollen particles using <Float> to give an immersive atmosphere without overwhelming the text.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise/grain SVG overlay across the entire site (pointer-events-none, opacity-20) to kill digital flatness and enhance the organic paper feel.
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Spotlight/clipped frames. Do not use border-radius-xl everywhere; use sharp edges or perfect circles to contrast natural organic photography. Never use heavy blanket overlays on images.

sections_breakdown.Header: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md, bg-[#F5F3E9]/80) floating nav with IT/EN toggle and contact link.
sections_breakdown.Hero: Massive kinetic text: 'HUMUS SAPIENS'. Background subtle R3F 3D particles. Organic layout.
sections_breakdown.Chi_Siamo: Numbered manifesto chapters using IBM Plex Mono for numbers ('01. Le Radici'). Asymmetrical grid.
sections_breakdown.Agricampeggio: Large photography section with editorial marquee running across it.
sections_breakdown.Bee_Humus: Honey section. Background shifts to dark or uses warm honey accent. Spotlight on honeycomb image.
sections_breakdown.RAccolti: Social farming. Earthy deep soil background (#2B231D), light text. Focus on community.
sections_breakdown.Il_Luogo: Parallax landscape photo of Liguria mountains.
sections_breakdown.Contatti: Static showcase (no working form). Minimalist text, large email/address. Massive footer text.

Agricampeggio.description: Expansive green field under a dramatic sunset sky (User will replace later)

Il_Luogo.description: Liguria mountains and village (Val Petronio context)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Forest Green text against Off-White paper meets APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, language toggles, nav items) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for parallax and kinetic reveals.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic Shadcn components for the layout; build custom asymmetrical pure HTML+Tailwind sections.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main App wrapper.
For the Hero, use Framer Motion to reveal text line-by-line (y: 100% to 0) inside overflow-hidden wrappers.
Embed a simple Canvas from @react-three/fiber in the hero background with floating particles or an abstract shape.
Add a global SVG noise filter overlay to give the site a tactile, printed editorial feel.
The Contacts section should be a static showcase of info, no functional form is needed.
Incorporate a language toggle (IT/EN) in the header navigation.
Make the scrolling marquee for Agricampeggio organic and elegant, not like a cheap news ticker.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; no muddy gray transparency, ensure high color saturation and 1px borders.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header; use glassmorphism.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
